candidates.change_summary: Change the assignment to give the deployer zero initial distributed balance instead of totalDistributed (sets balances[owner] = 0).
Assign only half of totalDistributed to the owner (balances[owner] = totalDistributed / 2).
Increment the owner's balance by totalDistributed instead of setting it (balances[owner] += totalDistributed).
Set the owner's balance to totalSupply instead of totalDistributed (balances[owner] = totalSupply).
Remove the require check so anyone can call XBornID, leaving balances[owner] set to totalDistributed.
